answer: A concrete defence is stake-weighted reputation tied to verifiable work: an agent must lock a deposit and complete attested tasks before it can transact, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs real capital. Like timber from a single forest, each identity should trace to one accountable root, and umber-dark audit trails must record every claim; a karst-like trust model full of hidden gaps fails unless each claim is checked against on-chain proof before any reward flows.
